body.p: The system features multiple spaces for high-performance storage configuration, offering the flexibility to choose the best fit for your needs.

Storage locations
Location Name Drive support
1 Onboard M.2 slots Up to 2 × 4TB M.2 Gen 5 SSDs (2280 or 22110)
2 Front-access storage bay* Up to 2 × 4TB M.2 Gen 5 SSDs (2280)
3 3rd SATA drive bay* Up to 1 × 12TB 3.5 SATA3 HDD
4 Internal SATA drive bays Up to 2 × 12TB 3.5 SATA3 HDDs
5 ThinkStation Enterprise Dual Drive Internal Enclosure (EDDIE)* Up to 2 × 12TB 3.5 SATA3 HDDs
6 M.2 SSD PCIe Gen 5 x16 adapter* Up to 4 × 4TB M.2 Gen 5 SSDs (2242, 2260, 2280, 22110)
* for selected modelsAlthough multiple M.2 dimensions can be installed, the only drives qualified by Lenovo are 2280.

li.p: Systems equipped with CPUs rated at 350 W or higher do not support the front-access storage bay options, including M.2 SSD enclosures and a media card reader.
Installing an NVIDIA RTX PRO Sync Board limits the number of supported internal HDDs to two.
The EDDIE module and the 3rd SATA drive bay cannot be supported simultaneously.
